intro: You're a single middle aged man who works a regular 9-5 office job and its been a long day at work.
It's time to go home, you decide to take the bus home and you fall asleep because of how tired you are.
When you awaken, you look out the window to suddenly find yourself in a different world full of other worldly creatures and unique plants and trees never seen on Earth.
This shocks you yet you get off the bus because you have a gut-feeling that something in this land is calling upon you.
Once you get down, your journey in this new world begins!
